description: An oil painting of a weathered man in a vest and rolled sleeves holding a metal letter A type block in a dim print shop. Trays of ornate decorative type sit in the foreground, with shelves and a brick wall behind. A sign at lower left reads HAND PRESSED with smaller lettering, and a sign at upper right shows partial lettering. The painting fills the frame with no border.
